title: The high shelf
starting_code:
# Stand in line with the book.
# Draw it down with the spell.
hints: Walk to the left until you stand directly under the book.
Cast the spell `"fendra"` to bring the book down to you.
Remember to take the book in your hands before you walk on.
intro: A rare book rests on that high shelf. You cannot reach it by hand. This is a good place to use your new spell.
outro: You brought the book down smoothly. The spell is very useful.
learned: Now you know how to use a spell, a word of magic, with the cast method.
